shortDescription: Manage SNMP settings on PowerScale storage systems

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: read_only_community
options.description: SNMP read-only community name. The system default value of the read-only community name is C(I$ilonpublic). Update the read-only community name while enabling SNMP v2c.

options.name: service
options.description: Whether the SNMP service is enabled.

options.name: snmp_v2c_access
options.description: Whether the SNMP v2c is enabled. OneFS support SNMP v2c and later.

options.name: snmp_v3
options.description: Specify the access, privacy, and security level for SNMP v3.

options.name: system_contact
options.description: SNMP system owner contact information. This must be a valid email address. The contact information is set for the reporting purpose.

options.name: system_location
options.description: The cluster description for SNMP system. The cluster description is set for the reporting purpose.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
